ir.name: weighted_advantage_exp_margin_softplus_scaled_weighted_mean_loss_v5
ir.intuition: Repaired the insensitivity to objective by replacing the negated logsigmoid with a numerically stable softplus of the negative margin-scaled input. This increases gradient magnitude for small inputs, improving sensitivity to advantage_gap perturbations. The exponential margin scaling of normalized advantage_gap remains to maintain the margin property, but softplus better captures small differences and stabilizes gradients. The weighted mean aggregation and all input keys are preserved to ensure compatibility and effectiveness.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
mean_adv = mean(advantage_gap)
margin = exp(clamp(abs(mean_adv), 0, 1)) - 1
norm = max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
x_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
x = margin * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = softplus(-x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    mean_adv = ops.mean(advantage_gap)
    margin = ops.sub(ops.exp(ops.clamp(ops.abs(mean_adv), 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0)
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    x_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    x = ops.mul(margin, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
